expected_issues.title: Double encoding issue: `url.UserPassword()` already handles URL encoding internally
expected_issues.description: Double encoding issue: `url.UserPassword()` already handles URL encoding internally. Using `url.QueryEscape()` before passing credentials will cause double encoding. For example, if password contains '@', it becomes '%40', then url.UserPassword encodes '%' to '%25', resulting in '%2540'. Remove the QueryEscape calls.

expected_issues.description: getDBHost(): this rejects valid MongoDB connection strings like `mongodb+srv://...` and also doesn’t handle multiple hosts in `Host` (replica sets) beyond returning the first hostname. Consider accepting both `mongodb` and `mongodb+srv` schemes and/or parsing host list explicitly (e.g., split parsedURL.Host on "," and take the first, or keep the full host list for logging).

known_false_positives.description:
**Bug: Logging pointer instead of database name**

This log statement will print the pointer representation of `c.Database` (which is of type `*mongo.Database`) instead of the database name string. This makes the log message unhelpful.

Example output:
```
connected to MongoDB at localhost to database &{0xc0001234...}
```

**Fix:**

```suggestion
c.logger.Logf("connected to MongoDB at %v to database %v", host, c.config.Database)
```
